feature: Neoshop vehicle designs (halved prices, buy/insufficient-coins flows) + Neon Garage (equip/locked states, persistence) + Neon Highway garage entry button
summary: Backend (SQL migrations 013-026) 13/13 ok, yarn test 55/55 passing, typecheck clean. Of 8 UI/mechanics criteria: 1 (six designs/halved prices), 6 (persistence after reload), 7 (SQL-025 fallback hint + round still plays), and 8 (game mechanics/unit tests) pass cleanly. 3 browser checks found a REAL, reproducible frontend bug (criteria 2, 3, 4): clicking the 'highway-garage-button' on a freshly-loaded /arcade/highway start screen, and clicking tab/buy buttons on a freshly-loaded /neoshop page, silently does nothing (no state change, no dialog, no error). Root cause (confirmed via server logs): NeonGarage.tsx line 88 calls createPortal(..., document.body) with no SSR guard; TanStack Start's SSR throws 'document is not defined' when that component (or a route that Link-preloads it) is rendered server-side, and the subsequent 'switched to client rendering' recovery leaves plain onClick-driven buttons on that page inert (Link/anchor navigation still works). Opening the garage via the ?garage=1 search param (bypassing the broken button) proves NeonGarage's own internal logic (locked/equipped states, skin selection, equip rpc call, server-truth persistence after reload) all work correctly once mounted that way - so criteria 5 and 6 were additionally verified successfully through that side door. Criteria 2, 3 and 4 remain failing as reported because the primary documented user path (tap-to-open) is broken.

bugs.criterion: Garage button in Neon Highway start menu / Purchase flow / Insufficient coins dialog
bugs.description: NeonGarage.tsx line 88 does `createPortal(<dialog/>, document.body)` without any SSR guard (no typeof document check / client-only gating). TanStack Start's SSR throws 'ReferenceError: document is not defined' whenever this component is server-rendered -- which happens not only when /arcade/highway?garage=1 is the requested URL, but also in the background whenever a route that could render it is reached (observed on a plain /neoshop load too, likely via router Link-preloading of /arcade/highway?garage=1). The framework recovers by switching to full client rendering, but on the affected page plain onClick/useState-driven buttons (tab switches, Buy buttons, the 'Neon Garage' open button) stop responding to taps -- while <Link>-based navigation keeps working. Net effect: the primary documented entry point to the Neon Garage (tapping the button) does not open it, and the Neoshop's buy / insufficient-coins dialogs never appear on a user's first visit to that page.
bugs.evidence: Server log (/var/log/supervisor/frontend.err.log): 'Error in renderToReadableStream: ReferenceError: document is not defined at NeonGarage (/app/src/components/arcade/NeonGarage.tsx:88:1)'. Reproduced in 3 independent browser checks (highway-garage-button-opens-dialog, neoshop-purchase-deducts-coins-once-mocked, neoshop-insufficient-coins-dialog-mocked); screenshots captured for each showing the click having no visible effect. Workaround confirmed: opening the same dialog via the ?garage=1 URL avoids the bug entirely and all subsequent interactivity (equip, skin selection, reload-persistence) works correctly, isolating the defect to the SSR-crash/recovery path rather than NeonGarage's own logic.

action_items: Fix: guard NeonGarage's createPortal target, e.g. render only when `typeof document !== 'undefined'` (or mount via useEffect/useState so the portal only ever runs client-side), so SSR never touches `document.body` for this component.

After the fix, re-run (by name only) highway-garage-button-opens-dialog, neoshop-purchase-deducts-coins-once-mocked, and neoshop-insufficient-coins-dialog-mocked to confirm the button-driven flows work end-to-end.
Matrix has 8 criteria; all 8 were exercised (7 browser checks + 1 combined backend/unit-test lane entry covering SQL migrations, yarn test and typecheck).
